1: // Simple Meteor Dodge game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
7:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8: 
9:   // Audio setup
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   // Resume audio context on first user interaction
12:   const resumeAudio = () => { audioCtx.state === 'suspended' && audioCtx.resume(); };
13:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, { once: true });
14:   canvas.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio, { once: true });
15: 
16:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
20:     osc.type = 'sine';
21:     osc.connect(gain);
22:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     osc.start();
25:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:   }
27: 
28:   // Background music loop (low hum)
29:   let musicInterval = null;
30:   function startMusic() {
31:     if (musicInterval) return;
32:     musicInterval = setInterval(() => playTone(80, 0.5), 2000);
33:   }
34:   // Start music after first interaction
35:   window.addEventListener('keydown', startMusic, { once: true });
36:   canvas.addEventListener('click', startMusic, { once: true });
37: 
38:   // Ship (triangle)
39:   const ship = { w: 40, h: 30, x: width / 2, y: height - 40, speed: 5 };
40: 
41:   // Meteors array
42:   const meteors = [];
43:   const meteorSpawnInterval = 800; // ms
44:   let lastSpawn = 0;
45:   let score = 0;
46:   let lives = 3;
47:   let gameOver = false;
48: 
49:   // Starfield background
50:   const stars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
51:     x: Math.random() * width,
52:     y: Math.random() * height,
53:     r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
54:   }));
55: 
56:   // Input handling
57:   const keys = {};
58:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
59:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
60:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
61:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
62:     ship.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
63:   });
64: 
65:   function spawnMeteor() {
66:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
67:     meteors.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: Math.random() * 2 + 2 });
68:   }
69: 
70:   function update(dt) {
71:     if (gameOver) return;
72:     // Ship movement (arrow keys)
73:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
74:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
75:     // Clamp ship position
76:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
77: 
78:     // Spawn meteors
79:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > meteorSpawnInterval) {
80:       spawnMeteor();
81:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
82:     }
83: 
84:     // Update meteors
85:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
86:       const m = meteors[i];
87:       m.y += m.speed;
88:       // Collision with ship
89:       if (m.x < ship.x + ship.w && m.x + m.w > ship.x && m.y < ship.y + ship.h && m.y + m.h > ship.y) {
90:           // Play collision sound
91:           playTone(200, 0.2);
92:           lives--;
93:           meteors.splice(i, 1);
94:           if (lives <= 0) gameOver = true;
95:           continue;
96:       }
97:       // Remove off-screen meteors, increment score
98:       if (m.y > height) {
99:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
100:           // Play point sound
101:           playTone(400, 0.05);
102:           score++;
103:       }
104:     }
105:   }
106: 
107:   function draw() {
108:     // Background
109:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
110:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
111:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
112:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
113:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
114:     // Starfield
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
116:     stars.forEach(s => {
117:       ctx.beginPath();
118:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
119:       ctx.fill();
120:     });
121:     // Draw ship as triangle
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
123:     ctx.beginPath();
124:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
125:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
126:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
127:     ctx.closePath();
128:     ctx.fill();
129:     // Draw meteors with radial gradient
130:     meteors.forEach(m => {
131:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
132:         m.x + m.w / 2,
133:         m.y + m.h / 2,
134:         0,
135:         m.x + m.w / 2,
136:         m.y + m.h / 2,
137:         m.w / 2
138:       );
139:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff7733');
140:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aa3300');
141:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
142:       ctx.beginPath();
143:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2, m.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
144:       ctx.fill();
145:     });
146:     // UI
147:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
148:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
149:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
150:     ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${lives}`, 10, 40);
151:     if (gameOver) {
152:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
153:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
154:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
155:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
156:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
157:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
158:     }
159:   }
160:   }
161: 
162:   let lastTime = 0;
163:   function loop(timestamp) {
164:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
165:     lastTime = timestamp;
166:     update(dt);
167:     draw();
168:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
169:   }
170:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
171: })();
